title.en: Unit 1 Notes — Fundamentals of Steel Design
title.gu: યુનિટ 1 Notes — Steel Design ના મૂળભૂત સિદ્ધાંતો

h.en: 1.1 Steel and RCC as structural materials
h.gu: 1.1 Structural materials તરીકે Steel અને RCC

items.syllabus_item: 1.1 steel versus RCC; advantages and disadvantages

body.en:
Steel has high strength relative to weight, ductility, predictable manufactured properties, shop fabrication and rapid site erection. Bolted connections permit disassembly and reuse. Long spans and lightweight trusses are practical. Limitations include corrosion in adverse exposure, rapid loss of strength and stiffness in fire, instability of slender members, fabrication and connection sensitivity, and need for inspection and protective maintenance.

Reinforced cement concrete (RCC) combines concrete primarily resisting compression with steel reinforcement resisting tension. RCC is readily formed on site and its concrete cover protects reinforcement when correctly designed and maintained; it is relatively heavy, needs formwork and curing, and cracked concrete can allow corrosion. Fire and corrosion resistance are not automatic for either material. Choose considering loads, span, exposure, availability, construction sequence, cost and lifecycle; hybrid systems are common.
body.gu:
Steel માં વજનની સરખામણીએ ઊંચી strength, ductility, નિયંત્રિત manufacturing, shop fabrication અને ઝડપથી site erection જેવા ફાયદા છે. Bolted connections ખોલીને reuse કરી શકાય છે. લાંબા spans અને હળવા trusses શક્ય બને છે. મર્યાદામાં પ્રતિકૂળ exposure માં corrosion, આગમાં strength તથા stiffness ઝડપથી ઘટવી, slender members માં instability, fabrication/connection પ્રત્યે સંવેદનશીલતા અને inspection તથા protective maintenance ની જરૂર છે.

Reinforced cement concrete (RCC) માં concrete મુખ્યત્વે compression અને steel reinforcement tension નો પ્રતિકાર કરે છે. યોગ્ય design અને maintenance માં concrete cover reinforcement ને રક્ષણ આપે છે; RCC ભારે હોય છે તથા formwork અને curing જરૂરી છે. કોઈ material માં fire કે corrosion resistance આપોઆપ મળતું નથી. Loads, span, exposure, availability, construction sequence, cost અને lifecycle પ્રમાણે પસંદગી કરો; hybrid systems પણ સામાન્ય છે.

items.syllabus_item: 1.1 types of steel sections normally in use

body.en:
Rolled sections include I/H beams and columns, channels (C), angles (L), tees (T), flats, plates and circular or rectangular hollow sections. Built-up sections combine plates or shapes using welds or bolts to obtain a required cross-section; they require connection and stability checks. A designation identifies a section family and nominal dimensions or mass, but dimensions, area A, mass per metre, moments of inertia I, section moduli Z and radii of gyration r must be read from the appropriate current steel table.

Flanges and web resist different distributions of bending, shear and local buckling. An angle used as a truss member may connect through one leg, creating eccentricity and shear lag. Do not replace a manufacturer’s tabulated rounded-corner area with a sharp-corner arithmetic approximation without stating the assumption.
body.gu:
Rolled sections માં I/H beams અને columns, channels (C), angles (L), tees (T), flats, plates તથા circular અથવા rectangular hollow sections છે. Built-up sections માં જરૂરી cross-section માટે plates અથવા shapes ને weld કે bolt થી જોડાય છે; connections અને stability તપાસ જરૂરી છે. Designation section family અને nominal dimensions અથવા mass દર્શાવે છે, પરંતુ dimensions, area A, mass per metre, moments of inertia I, section moduli Z અને radii of gyration r યોગ્ય current steel table માંથી લો.

Flanges અને web પર bending, shear તથા local buckling જુદી રીતે અસર કરે છે. Truss માં angle એક leg થી જોડાય ત્યારે eccentricity અને shear lag આવી શકે. Assumption જણાવ્યા વગર manufacturer ના tabulated rounded-corner area ના સ્થાને sharp-corner arithmetic approximation ન લો.

items.syllabus_item: 1.2 stress strain curve for mild steel

body.en:
In the initial approximately linear elastic range, stress is proportional to strain and unloading approximately recovers the deformation. The slope is Young’s modulus E, commonly taken as 2 × 10⁵ MPa for structural steel. Mild steel can show upper and lower yield behaviour and a yield plateau, followed by strain hardening, maximum engineering stress and necking to fracture. Not every steel grade has a distinct yield plateau; the design yield strength and thickness-related grade values come from the relevant material standard.

Engineering stress is load divided by original area; engineering strain is change in length divided by original gauge length. Ductility is useful for warning and redistribution where permitted, but does not remove buckling, brittle fracture, fatigue or connection failure risks. The curve is schematic; design is based on specified material properties rather than reading a sketch.
body.gu:
શરૂઆતના લગભગ linear elastic range માં stress, strain ના પ્રમાણમાં છે અને unloading પછી deformation લગભગ પાછું આવે છે. Slope એટલે Young’s modulus E; structural steel માટે સામાન્ય રીતે 2 × 10⁵ MPa લેવામાં આવે છે. Mild steel માં upper/lower yield અને yield plateau, પછી strain hardening, maximum engineering stress અને necking પછી fracture દેખાઈ શકે છે. દરેક steel grade માં સ્પષ્ટ yield plateau હોવું જરૂરી નથી; design yield strength અને thickness આધારિત grade values સંબંધિત material standard માંથી લો.

Engineering stress = load / original area અને engineering strain = length change / original gauge length. Ductility ચેતવણી અને મંજૂર હોય ત્યાં redistribution માં મદદ કરે છે, પરંતુ buckling, brittle fracture, fatigue અથવા connection failure દૂર કરતી નથી. Curve schematic છે; design માટે sketch માંથી વાંચેલી કિંમત નહીં પરંતુ specified properties વાપરો.

h.en: 1.4 Characteristic and design values; partial safety factors
h.gu: 1.4 Characteristic અને design values; partial safety factors

items.syllabus_item: 1.2 characteristic and design strength partial safety factors loads and materials

body.en:
Characteristic strength is the specified statistical strength of the material; design strength is the characteristic strength reduced by the relevant material partial factor for the applicable limit state. For gross yielding of structural steel, IS 800:2007 commonly uses γm0 = 1.10, so design yield stress is fy/γm0. For rupture, γm1 is commonly 1.25; connection, weld and fabrication conditions have separate factors. Always identify the limit state and code clause rather than applying one factor to all checks.

Factored loads use load factors from IS 800 load-combination tables and the applicable loading codes; for a common ultimate combination of dead and imposed load, 1.5(DL + LL) is used when applicable. Other combinations including wind, favourable dead load, earthquake or serviceability have different factors and signs. Do not multiply a previously factored load a second time or use a strength combination blindly for serviceability.
body.gu:
Characteristic strength material ની specified statistical strength છે; design strength એ લાગુ limit state માટે સંબંધિત material partial factor વડે ઘટાડેલી કિંમત છે. Structural steel ના gross yielding માટે IS 800:2007 માં સામાન્ય રીતે γm0 = 1.10 લેવાય છે, તેથી design yield stress = fy/γm0. Rupture માટે γm1 સામાન્ય રીતે 1.25 છે; connection, weld અને fabrication conditions માટે અલગ factors છે. દરેક check માટે limit state અને code clause ઓળખો; એક factor બધે ન લગાવો.

Factored loads માટે IS 800 load-combination tables અને લાગુ loading codes ના factors વાપરો; સામાન્ય ultimate dead અને imposed load combination માં લાગુ હોય ત્યારે 1.5(DL + LL) લેવાય છે. Wind, favourable dead load, earthquake અથવા serviceability માટે અન્ય factors અને signs હોઈ શકે છે. પહેલેથી factored load ને ફરી factor ન કરો કે strength combination ને serviceability માટે અંધપણે ન વાપરો.

h.en: 1.5 Limit states of strength and serviceability
h.gu: 1.5 Strength અને serviceability ના limit states

items.syllabus_item: 1.3 limit state of strength and serviceability

body.en:
Limit state design checks that the structure is unlikely to reach unacceptable states over its design life. Strength limit states include yielding, rupture, buckling, connection failure, overturning and fatigue where applicable. The factored action effect must not exceed the relevant design resistance, with all required interaction, stability and detailing checks.

Serviceability covers deflection, vibration, deformation and durability or functional performance under the specified service combinations. A member can satisfy strength and still deflect too much; conversely an acceptable deflection does not establish strength. IS 800:2007 together with the current applicable amendments, IS 875 loading parts and SP 6 section properties is the syllabus reference. Numerical examples are educational and not construction approvals.
body.gu:
Limit state design માં design life દરમિયાન structure અસ્વીકાર્ય states સુધી પહોંચવાની સંભાવના મર્યાદિત રહે તે તપાસાય છે. Strength limit states માં yielding, rupture, buckling, connection failure, overturning અને લાગુ fatigue આવે છે. Factored action effect સંબંધિત design resistance કરતાં વધુ ન હોવો જોઈએ; જરૂરી interaction, stability અને detailing checks પણ કરો.

Serviceability માં નિર્ધારિત service combinations હેઠળ deflection, vibration, deformation અને durability અથવા functional performance આવે છે. Member strength માં પાસ હોવા છતાં deflection વધુ હોઈ શકે; યોગ્ય deflection થી strength સાબિત થતી નથી. IS 800:2007, લાગુ current amendments, IS 875 loading parts અને SP 6 section properties syllabus references છે. Numerical examples શૈક્ષણિક છે, construction approvals નથી.

title.gu: Numerical 1.1 — Design yield stress ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: For a specified steel yield strength fy = 250 MPa and γm0 = 1.10, find design yield stress.

Step 1. Write the applicable yielding expression.

Design yield stress = fy / γm0

Step 2. Substitute the values.

Design yield stress = 250 / 1.10

Final answer:

Design yield stress ≈ 227.27 MPa.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Steel માટે fy = 250 MPa અને γm0 = 1.10 છે. Design yield stress ગણો.

Step 1. લાગુ yielding expression લખો.

Design yield stress = fy / γm0

Step 2. કિંમતો મૂકો.

Design yield stress = 250 / 1.10

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Design yield stress ≈ 227.27 MPa.

title.en: Numerical 1.2 — Factored dead and live load
title.gu: Numerical 1.2 — Factored dead અને live load

body.en:
Given: A member carries DL = 40 kN and LL = 20 kN. For the specified ultimate combination 1.5(DL + LL), find factored load.

Step 1. Add the specified service loads.

DL + LL = 40 + 20DL + LL = 60 kN

Step 2. Apply the stated factor once.

Factored load = 1.5 × 60

Final answer:

Factored load = 90 kN.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Member પર DL = 40 kN અને LL = 20 kN છે. આપેલ ultimate combination 1.5(DL + LL) માટે factored load શોધો.

Step 1. આપેલ service loads ઉમેરો.

DL + LL = 40 + 20DL + LL = 60 kN

Step 2. આપેલ factor એક વાર લગાવો.

Factored load = 1.5 × 60

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Factored load = 90 kN.

body.en:
Given: A steel specimen has elastic stress 100 MPa and E = 200000 MPa. Find strain assuming linear elasticity.

Step 1. Apply Hooke’s law.

Strain = stress / E

Step 2. Substitute values in consistent units.

Strain = 100 / 200000

Final answer:

Strain = 0.0005 = 500 microstrain.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Steel specimen માં elastic stress 100 MPa અને E = 200000 MPa છે. Linear elasticity ધારી strain શોધો.

Step 1. Hooke’s law વાપરો.

Strain = stress / E

Step 2. સુસંગત units માં કિંમતો મૂકો.

Strain = 100 / 200000

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Strain = 0.0005 = 500 microstrain.

body.en:
